as_told.title: Dean Koontz's The Eyes of Darkness and the 'Wuhan 400' bioweapon

plain: The American novelist Dean Koontz wrote a book, The Eyes of Darkness, about a perfect bioweapon called Wuhan 400 developed at a lab near Wuhan, China, and set in 2020, the year of COVID, according to Michels. He tells this himself on two episodes and says the novel was written in 1981. He raises it as an example of fiction that seems to foresee real events, which, if more than coincidence, would suggest some kind of glimpse of the future.
